text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On my way to the trainers' lounge, I
notice
Marvelous Sunday talking to a
prospective
student.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You came for the academy's open house,

right?! ☆ What did ya think?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing—everyone's so fast. But I
don't think I
could keep up with the
training...

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm not even good enough to win a
single race.
I've always wanted to, but...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You can't give up on your marvelous dreams
before the starting line! ☆
Chasing them is the
whole reason you're
here, isn't it? ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I know! I'm gonna show you all the
marvelous things Tracen Academy has to
offer—the stuff
they didn't show you for
the open house! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Hop on my back! Marvelous Sunday's
Marvelous
Academy Tour is a go!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday races off with the
prospective
student clinging on for dear
life!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Wasn't that one of the open
house
participants? Why is Marvelous
running off with
her?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Stop right this instant!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Marvey?! Are you giving out random
piggyback
rides now?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! ☆ I'm giving her a Marvelous
Academy
Tour!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds fun! Oh, watch out!
Air
Groove's right on your tail!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't let her catch you, Marvey! I'll
cheer you on
from the sidelines!

Popcorn, where's my popcorn...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is that Marvelous and the vice
prez?
Youngsters these days have a lot
of energy, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! You can do it, you two!
Whatever it is!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Last stop: the academy's training course!
We're
almost at the finish line! ☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
There you are! Oh, when I catch you,
Marvelous
Sunday—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
She found us! ☆ Time for the last
spurt! ★

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I'm weighing you down—she's
definitely
going to catch us!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it! ☆ Just hold on, 'cause I'm
gonna
make this a marvelous finish! ★

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Wow! It's like we're one with
the wind!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But she's gaining on us! Don't lose,
Marvelous!
You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You bet I can! ☆★ Just... a little...
further!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: All right, this game of tag is over!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Marvelous Sunday's valiant
effort, Air
Groove catches up to her just
before the finish
line.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Finally. You've got some explaining to
do,
Marvelous Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. So you were trying to inspire
her.
What do you think, new prospect?
Did it work?

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! Hearing everyone cheer us on
was
amazing. It made me remember that
I'm not
alone!

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
And even when things looked bad,
Marvelous
never gave up... I wanna be
just like her!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Now you get it! ☆ Friends cheering each
other on
is marvelous, and so is having
the spirit to always
move forward! ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
That's the heart of what Tracen
Academy stands
for! ☆ Isn't it
marvelous? ★ Ahahahahaha! ☆

text_block_list.name: Younger Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh. I like the fire in your eyes.
Anyway,
I suppose I'll overlook your little

getaway act, Marvelous Sunday.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yay! That's marvelously kind of you,
Vice Prez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Marvelous Sunday's
impromptu tour, it looks like Tracen
Academy has gained a
promising new
racer!
